ops_data_result.summary: Analyzed 87 shipment rows across 4 locations. Found 3 data quality issue(s) and 1 unknown item ID(s). Location concentration: medium (HHI=0.315). Analysis mode: cross_sectional.

trend_analysis.note: CSV has no date column; analysis is cross-sectional over the full incoming shipment batch (single snapshot).

concentration_risk.interpretation: Boston-MGH is the largest recipient at 41.4%.

data_quality_issues.detail: 5 rows have a null unique_item_id (item_ids affected: [10021, 10022, 10035]). These units cannot be individually tracked or verified at point of delivery.

data_quality_issues.issue: Duplicate unique_item_id assigned across multiple dispatch locations
data_quality_issues.detail: 5 unique IDs appear at >1 facility. Examples: ['ALB-2026-5003', 'EPI-2026-2002', 'HEP-2026-3001', 'MOR-2026-4002', 'PBR-2026-1201']. A single serialized unit cannot be at two locations — indicates a barcode/labeling error or a data entry mistake.

data_quality_issues.issue: item_id 10021 dosage ambiguity (all names valid per Playbook §8)
data_quality_issues.detail: Names found for item_id 10021: ['Remdesivir 100mg', 'Remdesivir 200mg']. All names are valid Playbook §8 variants (Antiviral, Cold (2-8C)), but the CSV rows do not distinguish which specific variant was shipped. Confirm with the warehouse which dosage was actually packed before dispatch.

item_master_matches.note: item_id 10071 ('Albuterol Inhaler') is not in the Item Master. Strong substitute candidate: item_id 10070 ('Albuterol Inhaler', Bronchodilator, Room Temp (20-25C)) with score 1.0. Likely a duplicate ID or typo — verify with Inventory.

constraints.rule: Planner must acknowledge material data quality issues and explain how they affect dispatch confidence before finalizing the plan.
Planner must explain the dispatch impact of volume concentration and any period-over-period or cross-sectional trend anomalies identified by OpsDataAgent.

recommendations.recommendation: Resolve 5 null unique_item_id records (5.8% of shipment) before dispatch. Contact the warehouse team to assign barcodes or pull from backup manifest.
Investigate the cross-location unique_item_id duplicates. Confirm correct destination for each unit and re-label if necessary to prevent misrouting.
Resolve item_name discrepancy for item_id 26 records. A dosage mismatch (e.g., 100mg vs 200mg) is a patient-safety risk — hold affected units pending confirmation from the clinical pharmacist.
Escalate unknown item_ids ['10071'] to the Inventory team for Item Master registration. Do not dispatch unregistered items until they are validated.
